description: Ministry of Provincial  Council and Local Government -  Amendment to the Ex. Gaz. No. 2043/56 of 02.11.2017 Elpitiya P/S
categorisation: This gazette content involves the repeal of a previous order and amendments related to the Pradeshiya Sabhas Act, which constitutes a legal/regulatory action. It deals with statutory instruments and modifications to existing legislation, falling clearly under the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5). While it mentions a minister's name, it does not include detailed portfolio responsibilities or government structural changes that would qualify it for Types 1-3.
